v3_2_3.0: A sheet for the substitute: "Substitute" on the export page prints the plan with just the names, class, room and date, plus a note

v3_2_3.8: Undoing the removal of a student brings their photo back too

v3_2_3.11: Locks are saved with the plan, and "Set up from scratch" no longer puts locked students on the wrong seats
v3_2_3.12: Coming back from the "Library", the export or a class tool, the workspace is as you left it
v3_2_3.13: Hiding room elements in the export leaves the seating plan as it is
v3_2_3.14: After mixing, the students glide to their seats evenly, without a jump
v3_2_3.15: "Where does who sit?" finds names typed without accents, such as "Celine" for Céline

v3_2_2.0: On a phone or tablet held upright, the room and the seating plan stand upright and fill the screen

v3_2_2.3: "Who's next?" shows the drawn student's seat in the plan or the circle

v3_2_1.0: "Theme as the system" in the settings menu: light and dark follow the device again

v3_2_1.2: Marks on the seats follow the tables' rounded corners and are no longer cut off
v3_2_1.3: On the export sheet, the board, windows and door are lighter, so the seats stand out

v3_2_1.5: Changes are no longer lost when you switch classes or leave the page
v3_2_1.6: A full storage or a failed read no longer makes classes or data disappear
v3_2_1.7: Student photos are no longer deleted by mistake
v3_2_1.8: Undo no longer brings back deleted students or the state from before a restored backup

v3_2_1.10: The presentation and the class tools no longer use plans for tables that are gone
v3_2_1.11: A saved plan no longer shows as unsaved by mistake, nor is it saved twice

v3_2_1.13: The CSV import reads "sehr unruhig" and "sehr schüchtern" correctly

v3_2_0.0: "Notes" in the seating plan's inspector name what the class and the room cannot meet, such as too few front seats
v3_2_0.1: Backups are now .klassenplan files; in Chrome and Edge a double-click opens one in the installed app
v3_2_0.2: "Install as App" in the gear menu shows how to install Klassenplan in your browser
v3_2_0.3: A guide for a school's IT on installing Klassenplan on every computer
v3_2_0.4: Mixing meets preferred partners and distance requests far better, and the fulfilment percentages mean what they say
v3_2_0.5: "Mix" tries three starts, keeps the best plan and is still faster than before
v3_2_0.6: A plan is now saved and opened in its inspector; Ctrl/⌘+S still saves straight away
v3_2_0.7: Classes, rooms and templates no longer need dialogs, and names are changed right in the inspector's header
v3_2_0.8: All inspectors share one layout, with a row per setting and menus instead of long lists

v3_2_0.11: In the circle, students with a distance request, restless and distractible students sit apart where possible
v3_2_0.12: "Add student" and "Create placeholders" are under "Add" in the toolbar
v3_2_0.13: Searching the class list opens the matching student while you type

v3_2_0.17: The FAQ explains mixing, the fulfilment and installing the app

v3_2_0.19: "Repetition" counts only the plans that were really in use

v3_2_0.22: Several mixing fixes, for instance for students who need a front seat

updateNotice.intro: Klassenplan has been updated. Here are the key improvements at a glance.

redesign.title: Welcome to the new Klassenplan
redesign.subtitle: Version {{version}} has been rebuilt. Your classes and plans are all still there – just arranged more clearly.

layout.title: One layout for everything
layout.body: At the top you switch between the layers Class, Room and Plan. Every layer is built the same way: the toolbar on the left, the stage in the middle, the inspector on the right – where you edit whatever is selected – and the status bar at the bottom with undo, mixing and the way on. Settings and Help are at the top right.

rooms.title: Plans now belong to a room
rooms.body: A class can have several rooms – the classroom and the lab, say – each with its own tables, plans and mixes. Your plans so far are in the room "Classroom". A plan is saved in the room you mixed it in; you name it when you save it from the toolbar.

library.title: "Library" instead of "Plans, mixes & neighbourhoods"
library.body: At the very bottom of the toolbar you find the Library: classes, rooms, plans, mixes, neighbourhoods and templates as folders in columns. There you open, move and delete plans and choose which ones count as used.

redesign.tourHint: The tour shows you the most important places on every layer and in the Library. Start it again at any time from "Help" at the top right.
